- Milestone 3: Procurement & legal review — target internal approvals by 2026-03-18.

Can you confirm the owners and the SSO delivery date so I can update the MAP and share the final for signature? If those dates look good I’ll also add a row for DocuSign/SOW readiness.

- Infra will send SSO requirements by EOD 2026-03-05 (see attached).

Marissa / team — quick final from our side: 

- Confirmed: owners for Procurement (Procurement Lead: procurement@fintechco.com) and Legal (Legal Lead: michael.lee@fintechco.com).
- Security confirmed they received the SOC 2 stub and the short questionnaire answers and will complete their review by 2026-03-18.
- Procurement is aligned to target SOW signature week of 2026-03-22. We will initiate DocuSign once Redwood uploads the final SOW.
- Confirm success criteria for pilot: (1) API integration completes without >1% error rate across validation traffic, (2) SSO authentication success rate >= 99% during test, (3) latency <200ms p50 for catalog endpoints — we are aligned on these.

We’re ready to sign as soon as the final SOW is in DocuSign. Please send when ready and we’ll route for signature. Looking forward to go-live on 2026-04-01.

Thanks,
